hero.subtitle: KOLKATA CHAPTER
hero.description: In today's interconnected world, storytelling is a bridge that unites diverse cultures. The Kolkata Film, Content Creators Festival & Award Ceremony 2027 celebrates the power of visual narratives — honoring the art of filmmaking and digital content creation, inspiring innovation in the creative industry.

page.title: RULES & REGULATIONS
page.description: Organised by IEM-UEM Group, SMART Society (USA), Bengal Heritage Foundation & Forum for Film Studies and Allied Arts

sections.heading: A. GENERAL RULES
sections.intro: CFCCF 2027 is a competitive short film festival aimed at promoting excellence in motion picture art and encouraging meaningful film culture worldwide, now returning to the cultural heartland of Kolkata.
rules: Films entered in the competitive section will be considered for the respective festival awards.
The selection committee will determine the films eligible for competition.
A film may be entered into only the category applicable to its format and subject.
The jury's decision regarding awards shall be final and binding.
The festival organisers reserve the right to withdraw an award in case of violation of festival regulations.
Awards and certificates will be presented according to the final jury decisions.

sections.heading: B. COMPETITIVE SECTION
sections.intro: CFCCF 2027 is a competitive short film festival aimed at promoting excellence in motion picture art and encouraging meaningful film culture worldwide, now returning to the cultural heartland of Kolkata.
rules: The festival is open to filmmakers from India and abroad.
Films must be submitted in accordance with the prescribed submission guidelines.
The submitted film must be the original work of the filmmaker or submitting organisation.
The applicant is responsible for obtaining all necessary rights and permissions for the submitted film.
The festival committee reserves the right to accept or reject any submission.
The decision of the selection committee shall be final.
Selected films may be screened during the festival and used for festival-related promotional activities.
Submission of a film implies acceptance of all festival rules and regulations.

page.title: ABOUT US
page.description: A collaboration between Bengal Heritage Foundation, The Forum for Film Studies & Allied Arts, and SMART Society — united by the love of cinema.

partners.title: FORUM FOR FILM STUDIES & ALLIED ARTS — KOLKATA
partners.description: The Forum for Film Studies and Allied Arts, Kolkata, promotes cinema through festivals, screenings, and tributes. Collaborating with embassies and institutions like Instituto Cervantes and SRFTI, it showcases international and Indian films and honors filmmakers such as Buddhadeb Dasgupta.

partners.title: SMART SOCIETY — USA & CANADA
partners.description: SMART Society is a US and Canada-based non-profit society aiming to create a pool of unique ideas and thoughts through power-packed talks. It serves as a platform for Markers, Artists, Researchers, and Technologists to bring forth their views to the world.
